prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign this ONE gold battle-record icon so it unmistakably depicts an UNROLLED JAPANESE PAPER SCROLL, while retaining its muted warm gold #C6A15B and lighter gold #E5C77E, bold simple flat emblem line art and clean small-UI aesthetic. Crucial geometry change: remove all FOUR corner spirals and the picture-frame geometry. Instead show a continuous sheet of paper with ONE broad horizontal rolled cylinder across its TOP and ONE broad horizontal rolled cylinder across its BOTTOM. The two rolls are full-width tubes with a clearly visible simple rounded rolled-paper end at one side each, not four symmetrical corner flourishes. Between the rolls the sheet is narrower, with slightly inward-curving left and right edges. Add only two short broad horizontal gold record strokes on the sheet, no actual writing. A subtle asymmetry to the rolled ends makes the paper construction obvious. Front-facing almost flat view, no elaborate perspective, no wooden frame, no four corner curls, no ornate border. Preserve actual transparent alpha background and transparent empty paper interior (outline icon, not solid filled parchment). Strong broad contour, legible at 20-24px. Square 512x512 PNG, centered, about 10 percent transparent padding on every side. No text, numbers, watermark, glow, shadow, badge, textured background, checkerboard or other objects. Change only the scroll geometry; keep the existing icon family's color and visual weight.
note: 戦績アイコンのみの改訂版。旧版と既存ZIPは履歴として維持。ゲーム未組み込み。
